body.title: Restore the JetBrains plugin test build
body.reproduction: Both Gradle test invocations stop at compileTestKotlin. Settings tests use SaveResult.Saved as a singleton, call removed requestLine, and pass obsolete PerRepoSection constructor arguments. The default run additionally fails storing the configuration cache for bundleBackendAssets; disabling the cache leaves the Kotlin errors.
body.rootCause: Test fixtures were not updated when Saved became a data class and transport/settings constructors changed. The asset Copy task also captures script/project references in provider mapping that Gradle cannot serialize for configuration caching.
body.fixIntent: Bring settings and transport fixtures onto supported APIs while preserving their wire/null-value and save-result assertions, and make backend asset bundling compatible with the intended Gradle configuration-cache behavior. Acceptance: test compilation succeeds, focused settings tests execute and pass, and two normal test-build invocations reuse the cache without the Copy-task serialization error. Do not introduce a compatibility gate for the deprecated IDE fork.
